|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (V)]] (version 2 of 2). Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). * '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 26 December 2025: “Functions as your apprentice. Battle destiny draws may not be added here. May deploy Mara Jade's Lightsaber here from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. If you just won a battle here, may retrieve a card with 'Mara' in game text. Immune to Rebel Barrier and attrition &lt; 4 (&lt; 5 if Luke on table).” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Mara Jade, The Emperor’s Hand”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (V)]] (published 2 December 2025) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings).
